guilds.name: CASK GUILD
guilds.grouping: Grouped by maturation, cellar craft, and cellar-to-service.

subgenres.name: Seasoning
styles: Rain & sun leaching of harsh tannins

subgenres.name: Rioja (DOCa)
subgenres.standards: Barrels: oak of approx. 225 L (not 330 L); continuous barrel time; red Crianza = 2 calendar years; Gran Reserva red = 60 mo total, ≥24 oak + ≥24 bottle; sparkling = tirage to disgorgement. Source: Pliego de condiciones DOCa Rioja (consolidated 15-02-2024), riojawine.com [verified online 2026-10-12]

subgenres.name: Ribera del Duero (DO)
subgenres.standards: Reds; oak barrels ≤330 L; remainder in bottle. Source: Pliego de condiciones DOP Ribera del Duero (DOUE 31-07-2023) [verified online 2026-10-12]

subgenres.name: Spain: Generic Terms (Ley 24/2003)
styles: Gran Reserva red · 5 yr (18 mo oak)
subgenres.standards: Oak ≤330 L; DO rules may be stricter. Source: Ley 24/2003 de la Viña y del Vino, art. 3 (boe.es) [from memory — unverified]

subgenres.name: Cava (DO)
subgenres.standards: Time on lees in bottle (tirage to disgorgement); Gran Reserva & Paraje: Brut Nature/Extra Brut/Brut only. Source: Pliego DOP Cava; cava.wine categories [verified online 2026-10-12]

subgenres.name: Sherry (Jerez-Xérès-Sherry)
subgenres.standards: Average age of the solera/criaderas system; VOS/VORS certified lot by lot. Source: Pliego DOP Jerez (2024); sherry.wine special categories [verified online 2026-10-12]

subgenres.name: Tuscany
styles: Chianti Classico Gran Selezione · 30 mo (3 btl)
Brunello Riserva · 6 yr (2 oak, 6 mo btl)
Rosso di Montalcino · release Sep 1 after harvest
Vino Nobile Riserva · 3 yr (6 mo btl)
subgenres.standards: Chianti Classico clock starts Jan 1 after harvest; Brunello release Jan 1 of 5th year after harvest (Riserva 6th), oak of any size. Sources: Disciplinare Chianti Classico (DM 22-06-2023); Disciplinare Brunello di Montalcino; Disciplinare Vino Nobile [verified online 2026-10-12]; Chianti (non-Classico) Riserva [from memory — unverified]

subgenres.name: Piedmont, Veneto & Campania
subgenres.standards: Barolo/Barbaresco clock from Nov 1 of harvest year; release Jan 1 of 4th (Barolo) / 3rd (Barbaresco) year after harvest. Amarone clock from Jan 1 after harvest (Riserva from Nov 1). Sources: Disciplinari Barolo, Barbaresco (masaf.gov.it), Amarone (consorziovalpolicella.it), Taurasi [verified online 2026-10-12]

subgenres.name: Italian Traditional-Method
subgenres.standards: Riserva requires vintage on label. Sources: Disciplinare Franciacorta DOCG (07-05-2024); Disciplinare Trento DOC [verified online 2026-10-12]

subgenres.name: Champagne & Crémant
styles: Crémant du Jura · 12 mo before release
subgenres.standards: Champagne minimums from tirage date (cahier des charges AOC Champagne, INAO) [verified online 2026-10-12]; 12 mo on lees within NV 15 mo (secondary sources); Crémant 9 mo on lees [from memory — unverified]; Crémant du Jura 12 mo (cahier des charges) [verified online 2026-10-12]

subgenres.name: Jura & Vins Doux Naturels
styles: Vin Jaune · 6 yr 3 mo (60 mo under voile)
subgenres.standards: Vin Jaune: release from January of 7th year, ≥60 months in oak under flor (voile). Sources: Cahiers des charges Côtes du Jura / Château-Chalon, Banyuls Grand Cru, Rivesaltes (INAO) [verified online 2026-10-12]

subgenres.name: Port (IVDP)
subgenres.standards: Vintage: approved year 2; LBV: approved year 4, bottled by Dec 31 of year 6. Source: IVDP categorias especiais [verified online 2026-10-12]; Tawny indicated ages & Reserve [from memory — unverified]

subgenres.name: Madeira (IVBAM)
subgenres.standards: Frasqueira: single harvest, recommended variety, canteiro aging. Sources: IVBAM rules via MW research paper [verified online 2026-10-12]; indicated-age ladder [from memory — unverified]

subgenres.name: Central Europe
styles: Tokaji Aszú · 18 mo wood, release yr 3
Austrian Sekt Große Reserve · 30 mo lees
subgenres.standards: Tokaj: release not before Jan 1 of 3rd year after harvest (Tokaj PDO specification, EU OJ C/2026/1380) [verified online 2026-10-12]; Austrian Sekt g.U. & Germany [from memory — unverified]

subgenres.name: Barrel-Aged & Wood Beers
styles: See Wine Academy: oak, toast, sizes

subgenres.name: Aging Requirements
styles: No legal aging minimums for beer
BJCP is a style guide, not law
subgenres.standards: Beer style names carry no legally mandated aging periods in the US/EU [from memory — unverified]

subgenres.name: Char Levels
styles: See Wine Academy: oak, forests, sizes

subgenres.name: Tequila (NOM-006)
subgenres.standards: Oak or holm-oak (encino), direct contact. Reposado has NO vessel-size limit and no legal upper bound (the popular '2–12 months' reflects that ≥1 yr in ≤600 L qualifies as Añejo). Source: NOM-006-SCFI-2012 §4.36 (DOF 13-12-2012) [verified online 2026-10-12]

subgenres.name: Mezcal (NOM-070)
subgenres.standards: Source: NOM-070-SCFI-2016 (DOF 23-02-2017) [verified online 2026-10-12]

subgenres.name: Whisk(e)y
styles: US Straight · 2 yr new charred oak
US age statement · required under 4 yr
subgenres.standards: Scotch: Scotch Whisky Regulations 2009; Japanese: JSLMA standard (mandatory for members from Apr 1 2024); US: 27 CFR 5.74 & 5.88 [verified online 2026-10-12]; Irish (Irish Whiskey Act 1980) & Canadian (Food and Drug Regulations B.02.020) [from memory — unverified]

subgenres.name: Grape & Fruit Brandy
subgenres.standards: Age = youngest eau-de-vie, oak only. Sources: BNIC/cahier des charges Cognac (arrêté 08-11-2018); IDAC Calvados labels [verified online 2026-10-12]; Armagnac XO 10 yr (since 2010) [from memory — unverified]

subgenres.name: Other Brandy & Pomace
styles: Brandy de Jerez Gran Reserva · 3 yr
subgenres.standards: Pisco: rest ≥3 months in glass, stainless steel or other neutral vessel (Reglamento DO Pisco) [verified online 2026-10-12]; Brandy de Jerez & grappa via secondary sources [from memory — unverified]

subgenres.name: Rum (Martinique AOC)
subgenres.standards: Continuous aging. Source: Cahier des charges AOC Rhum de la Martinique (INAO) [verified online 2026-10-12]; Jamaica GI / Barbados [from memory — unverified]
